title: The 10 Second Creeper Challenge
description: This datapack make minecraft creeper spawn every 10 seconds
body:
🧨 The 10-Second Creeper Challenge!
Can you survive Minecraft when a Creeper spawns on your head every single ten seconds?

This datapack introduces a chaotic survival challenge complete with a fully functional onscreen countdown timer so you always know exactly how many seconds of safety you have left!
⚙️Features
1.⏰ Action Timer: A clear display tracking the exact time left before the next explosion drops.
🎛️ Fully Toggleable Timer: Easily turn the timer on or off using an in-game command whenever you need a break to build.
💥Ultimate Chaos: Perfect for hardcore survival challenges, speedruns, or recording funny YouTube videos and Shorts!
🚀 How to Play
1.Download the ZIP folder.

2.Drag it directly into your Minecraft world's datapacks folder.

3.Enter your world and type /reload to activate the custom timer setup!

4.How to turn on the timer?Simply use this comman
Command:-/bossbar set creeper_timer players @s(@s for yourself only you have to toggle timer for every player If you want every player to see the timer)
